title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.16739v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs) are largely distinguished by their variance reduction strategy. Group-relative methods like GRPO reduce gradient variance by sampling multiple rollouts per prompt, but provide only sequence-level credit. Training is also blocked by straggler rollouts, reducing throughput and increasing off-policyness. Learned value functions theoretically address both problems, providing token-level advantages without requiring large groups. However, additional infrastructure engineering challenges combined with the practical success of critic-free methods have made it difficult to justify their inclusion in RL pipelines. translated_title: 批判者：用于大语言模型强化学习的特权价值函数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16739v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）的强化学习算法主要区别在于其方差减少策略。像GRPO这样的组相对方法通过为每个提示采样多个回滚来减少梯度方差，但仅提供序列级别的信用分配。训练还受到落后回滚的阻碍，降低了吞吐量并增加了偏离策略性。理论上，学习到的价值函数可以解决这两个问题，提供无需大组的令牌级别优势。然而，额外的基础设施工程挑战加上无批判者方法的实际成功，使得在强化学习管道中纳入它们难以合理化。我们提出了两种互补策略来提高价值函数强化学习的性能：1）特权价值函数（PVF），它提供了一种优雅的机制，在不偏置策略目标的情况下注入额外的任务相关令牌级信号；2）TETHER，一种基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出特权价值函数和TETHER策略，旨在通过注入任务相关信号并优化基线，提升大语言模型强化学习中价值函数方法的效率和稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Privileged Value Functions and TETHER strategy to enhance the efficiency and stability of value-function-based RL for LLMs by injecting task-relevant signals and optimizing baselines.
